fields.statement: QA at 912172a0 with a scratch build (go build ./cmd/rhiza) on a scratch root (rhiza root init) holding projects alpha, folder registered with project add --name other (each with three accepted milestone change sets with a leaf) and a bare uninitialised checkout, scratch HOME, fake rex/systemctl/loginctl on PATH, web port moved to 17787: daemon --once in an empty dir outside the root exits 2 with 'not inside a Rhiza root' and next: rhiza root init. With one daemon running in the background from the root, a second daemon --once from alpha/sub and from the root each exit 2 with 'another daemon holds the lock: process rhiza:<pid>'; the root's .rhiza-root/ holds daemon.lock.

QA at 912172a0 with a scratch build (go build ./cmd/rhiza) on a scratch root (rhiza root init) holding projects alpha, folder registered with project add --name other (each with three accepted milestone change sets with a leaf) and a bare uninitialised checkout, scratch HOME, fake rex/systemctl/loginctl on PATH, web port moved to 17787: with REX_SESSION unset and rex session ls empty, daemon --once ran rex session new rhiza-alpha and rex session new rhiza-other (cwd each project) once each, opened alpha's builder windows with -s rhiza-alpha and other's with -s rhiza-other, and rex.log never names rhiza-folder.

QA at 912172a0 with a scratch build (go build ./cmd/rhiza) on a scratch root (rhiza root init) holding projects alpha, folder registered with project add --name other (each with three accepted milestone change sets with a leaf) and a bare uninitialised checkout, scratch HOME, fake rex/systemctl/loginctl on PATH, web port moved to 17787: daemon set rhiza.daemon.maxRuns 3 (also from inside alpha) lands in rhiza.toml [daemon]; daemon set rhiza.autonomy.ship owner inside alpha and --project other rhiza.autonomy.plan auto at the root land in that repo's git config only; a project key at the root without --project exits 2 naming --project; a bad maxRuns exits 2; daemon settings and settings --project other --json list each key with scope machine/project and its source, trimGoCache machine.

QA at 912172a0 with a scratch build (go build ./cmd/rhiza) on a scratch root (rhiza root init) holding projects alpha, folder registered with project add --name other (each with three accepted milestone change sets with a leaf) and a bare uninitialised checkout, scratch HOME, fake rex/systemctl/loginctl on PATH, web port moved to 17787: daemon install from alpha/sub writes one rhiza-root.service with WorkingDirectory=<root> and ExecStart ... daemon --autonomous and runs systemctl --user enable --now rhiza-root.service; daemon stop, start and uninstall at the root call systemctl --user stop/start/disable --now rhiza-root.service and remove the unit. But rhiza daemon status at the root (service mode and tab mode alike) fails with 'sessions need a git repository: git rev-parse --git-common-dir: fatal: not a git repository'; it works only inside a project.

QA at 912172a0 with a scratch build (go build ./cmd/rhiza) on a scratch root (rhiza root init) holding projects alpha, folder registered with project add --name other (each with three accepted milestone change sets with a leaf) and a bare uninitialised checkout, scratch HOME, fake rex/systemctl/loginctl on PATH, web port moved to 17787: with rhiza.daemon.maxRuns = 3 in rhiza.toml (daemon status shows Max runs: 3), one daemon --once started six runs: all three of alpha's, then all three of other's. The machine-wide cap is applied per project and the picks are not round-robin; daemon.RoundRobin has no caller outside tests.

QA at 912172a0 with a scratch build (go build ./cmd/rhiza) on a scratch root (rhiza root init) holding projects alpha, folder registered with project add --name other (each with three accepted milestone change sets with a leaf) and a bare uninitialised checkout, scratch HOME, fake rex/systemctl/loginctl on PATH, web port moved to 17787: with machine maxRuns 3, one poll started six runs (three per project): the daemon does not stop when its running runs reach the machine-wide maxRuns. The milestone filter held: change sets serving no milestone were skipped with 'serves no milestone'.
